rewards_accrual_enabled.meaning: the target GTELaunchpadV2Pair has rewards accrual enabled

accrued_fees_present.meaning: the pair holds accrued launchpad fees (accruedLaunchpadFee0/accruedLaunchpadFee1) that attackers can generate themselves

no_token_transfers_in.meaning: no token transfers into the pair occur in the call

caller_has_no_special_permissions.meaning: the caller is any external user without special permissions, needing only gas to call mint(), swap(), or burn()

fees_counted_as_user_supplied.meaning: accrued launchpad fees held in the pair are counted as user-supplied amounts, letting a caller obtain tokens or liquidity beyond what they actually transferred in

locked_assets_drained.meaning: all locked assets (token0 and token1) of the pair have been drained by repeated silent exploitation

assumptions: mint(), swap(), and burn() are treated as alternative call paths available to the attacker, not a fixed sequence.
Accrued fees are assumed to be generatable by the attacker as stated, so the scenario is reachable without external fee accrual.
The report does not quantify drained amounts; the drain is modeled as the qualitative end state of repeated exploitation.

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify how many repeated calls or what per-call amount constitutes draining all locked assets; only the qualitative end state is stated.
Report does not specify whether mint(), swap(), and burn() are alternative or sequential steps in the repeated exploitation.

limitations: The drain impact is formalized as a qualitative Boolean end state because the report provides no numeric magnitudes or per-call amounts.
The claim covers only the selected impact imp_repeated_until_drained; other reported impacts are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
Code-level binding of the mint/swap/burn accounting gap is deferred; this plan encodes only report-stated observables.
